problem_objective_pairs.problem: Some surveyed parents of Grade 5 learners reported difficulty explaining lessons in printed modules to their children.
problem_objective_pairs.objective: Provide a short Science lesson before each level to give Grade 5 learners additional explanations during home study.

problem_objective_pairs.problem: Some surveyed Grade 5 teachers did not consider modular learning effective in helping learners understand lessons.
problem_objective_pairs.objective: Implement interactive exploration with movement and jumping controls and a review after each level to supplement printed Science learning materials.

problem_objective_pairs.problem: Some parents of Grade 5 learners reported landforms as a difficult Science topic for their children.
problem_objective_pairs.objective: Develop four episodes covering Mountains, Hills, Plains, and Plateaus, with lessons and exploration activities focused on these landforms.

problem_objective_pairs.problem: Some Grade 5 parent and teacher responses identified rocks or minerals as difficult Science topics.
problem_objective_pairs.objective: Implement rock and mineral collection, with a pop-up showing each collected item's name and short description.

visual_review: All eight final pages inspected; both lists display 1–4, no clipping/overlap/missing glyphs/stranded headings.
